svg.title: One training update, then repeat
svg.desc: Draw 32 windows with equal probability per training source. The student sees a transformed, masked view and predicts hidden features. The slow teacher sees the full original window. Compare only hidden slots, update the student and predictor using the loss, and update the teacher by a slow moving average.
